description: Returns who publishes MCP servers and how: the split between code host namespaces (io.github, io.gitlab, io.bitbucket) and publishers' own domains, by servers and by distinct namespaces. Example output: {"servers_by_namespace_type":{"io.github":31407,"own-domain":22209}}. No arguments. Good for 'What share of MCP servers use their own domain?'.
name: namespace_types
